headline.purpose: Workspace section headers (Draft board, Weekly decisions, Model room).

body.purpose: Paragraphs, form labels, buttons, inputs, dataframe cells.

label.purpose: Uppercase structural labels: evidence-strip field names, the stamp text, workspace-tab captions.

mark.purpose: Data values only: evidence-strip figures and chart data labels, tilted -1deg.

shadows.name: ledger-stack
shadows.purpose: Dataframe/table containers; paired with a 2px solid ink border for a stacked-paper feel.

shadows.name: stamped-button
shadows.purpose: Resting state for primary and download buttons.

shadows.name: pressed-stamp
shadows.purpose: Button hover state, paired with a 1px translate and border/text swap to red.

motion.name: button-press
motion.value: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s (implicit; no explicit easing declared)
motion.purpose: Hover transition on primary/download buttons: shadow shrinks and the button translates 1px toward the surface, like a stamp making contact.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below this width: container padding tightens, the stamp becomes an inline block, workspace-tab labels shrink and center, and the evidence strip reflows to a 2-column grid. The three-cell workspace row and the QB-only expander are unchanged at this breakpoint.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold, square-cornered call-to-action with a hard offset shadow that presses down to red on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d8a928; color: #17243b; border: 2px solid #17243b; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #17243b; font-family: Aptos, Tahoma, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #b7352d; color: #b7352d; transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #b7352d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2f6680; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: File Uploader Button
components.description: Gold action button with clipped corners, used for the model-sheet uploader inside the sidebar.
components.css: .ds-btn-upload { background: #d8a928; color: #17243b; border: 2px solid #fff7e7; border-radius: 0; font-weight: 800; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 8px) 0, 100% 8px, 100% 100%, 8px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 8px)); }

components.name: Workspace Tab Group
components.description: Three equal joined tabs selecting Draft Board / Weekly Decisions / Model Room; never stacks, even on mobile.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0; border-bottom: 4px solid #17243b; max-width: 31rem; } .ds-tab { background: #e8dec7; border: 1px solid #17243b; border-bottom: 0; padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem; margin-right: -1px; font-family: 'Bahnschrift Condensed', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; color: #17243b; } .ds-tab-active { background: #17243b; color: #fff7e7; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-tabs { max-width: none; } .ds-tab { font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.2rem; } }

components.name: Evidence Strip
components.description: Clipped-corner metadata ledger row under the masthead, pairing uppercase labels with tilted handwritten values.
components.css: .ds-evidence { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 1.6rem; background: #e8dec7; border-bottom: 1px solid #9d927b; padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem 0.8rem; font-family: 'Bahnschrift Condensed', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #17243b; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 12px) 0, 100% 12px, 100% 100%, 12px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 12px)); } .ds-evidence strong { color: #b7352d; display: inline-block; font-family: 'Segoe Print', 'Bradley Hand', cursive; letter-spacing: -0.04em; transform: rotate(-1deg); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-evidence { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

components.name: Masthead + Stamp
components.description: Ledger masthead with the display title and a rotated red status stamp in the corner.
components.html:
Fantasy War Room

Season value belongs on the draft board. Weekly matchups belong on their own desk.

Forward projection
components.css: .ds-masthead { position: relative; border-top: 10px solid #17243b; border-bottom: 3px solid #17243b; padding: 1rem 0 1.15rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-masthead h1 { margin: 0; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'Bahnschrift Condensed', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.035em; font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 5.3rem); line-height: 0.9; color: #17243b; } .ds-masthead p { color: #5d6670; font-family: Aptos, Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 0.6rem 0 0; max-width: 70ch; } .ds-stamp { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 1.25rem; border: 3px solid #b7352d; color: #b7352d; font-family: 'Bahnschrift Condensed', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.12em; padding: 0.4rem 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-2deg); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-stamp { position: static; display: inline-block; margin-top: 1rem; } }

components.name: Ranking Sheet Table
components.description: The draft-board / weekly-board data table, framed like a stacked ledger sheet with a hard offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-sheet { border: 2px solid #17243b; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 rgba(23, 36, 59, .16); background: #f3eedf; font-family: Aptos, Tahoma, sans-serif; color: #17243b; } .ds-sheet table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-sheet th { text-align: left; font-family: 'Bahnschrift Condensed', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border-bottom: 2px solid #17243b; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; } .ds-sheet td { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #9d927b; }

components.name: Sidebar Filing Panel
components.description: Permanent dark ink-navy control desk holding model-sheet loading and board filters.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { background: #17243b; border-right: 1px solid #78849a; padding: 1rem; color: #f8f1df; font-family: Aptos, Tahoma, sans-serif; } .ds-sidebar h2 { font-family: 'Bahnschrift Condensed', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.035em; color: #f8f1df; } .ds-sidebar select { background: #233552; border: 1px solid #78849a; border-radius: 0; color: #f8f1df; padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem; width: 100%; }

narrative.overview:
This is a working war room for player evidence, not a generic analytics dashboard: warm ruled paper stands in for a legal pad, ink-navy carries every hard rule and border, a rotated red stamp reports artifact status like a rubber stamp on a filed sheet, and gold marks the one action that matters on any given screen. The system never softens itself with rounded corners or blurred shadows — depth comes from flat, offset "stamp" shadows, and corners get personality only from clipped-path notches, never radius.

The build stays disciplined about role separation: ink structures, red marks status and hard-won facts (actuals, hover/error), gold acts, blue informs, and a cursive "handwritten" face is reserved exclusively for data values scrawled onto the ledger — never for body copy or structural labels. Three equal workspaces (Draft Board, Weekly Decisions, Model Room) sit as one unbroken row under the masthead at every viewport width, because moving between season-long and single-week decisions is the product's central promise.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ruled-paper canvas with a permanent dark ink-navy sidebar as the control desk
Zero border-radius everywhere; clipped-corner notches are the only corner treatment
Hard, non-blurred offset shadows ("ledger stack" / "stamped button"), never soft glows
A rotated red stamp and tilted cursive "handwritten" marks as the signature evidence devices
Three equal, never-stacking workspace tabs above a full-width ranking sheet

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only on primary buttons and the uploader control — the single actionable color on any screen. It is never used decoratively or for status.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Red never carries body text or long-form emphasis. It is reserved for the status stamp, handwritten actual-value marks, and the hover/error interaction states — always a fact or an action, never prose.

rules.name: The Handwritten Mark Rule
rules.body: Segoe Print (or its Bradley Hand fallback) appears only on data values and call-outs — the evidence strip's figures and chart data labels — never on structural labels, headings, or body copy.

rules.name: The Equal Three Rule
rules.body: The three workspace tabs (Draft Board / Weekly Decisions / Model Room) always render as one equal-width row. They never stack, wrap, or collapse into a dropdown, even at mobile widths — only their type size and padding shrink.

rules.name: The Flat Offset Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is a hard, non-blurred offset in a single flat color (`Npx Npx 0 color`). A soft or blurred box-shadow never appears in this system.

rules.name: The Hard Corner Rule
rules.body: No border-radius is ever non-zero. When a corner needs character, it is clipped with clip-path, not rounded — and clipping is reserved for ledger/tab-like surfaces (the evidence strip, the uploader button), not applied everywhere.

dos: Do reserve Segoe Print (or its cursive fallback) strictly for data values and call-outs — the evidence strip's figures and chart data labels — never for structural labels or body copy.
Do keep border-radius: 0 on every control; use clip-path notches, not rounding, when a corner needs character.
Do use hard, non-blurred offset shadows (Npx Npx 0 color) for elevation; never a blurred box-shadow.
Do keep the three workspace tabs in one equal-width row at every viewport width.
Do reserve Gold Highlight exclusively for primary actionable buttons and the uploader control.
donts: Don't use Red Stamp for body text or long-form content; it is reserved for the stamp, handwritten actual-value marks, and hover/error states.
Don't add soft or blurred shadows/glows anywhere; depth comes from flat, hard-edged offsets only.
Don't stack, wrap, or collapse the workspace tabs into a dropdown on mobile; shrink type and padding instead.
Don't introduce a second display face — Bahnschrift Condensed is the only heading/label face across headings, the stamp, and the evidence-strip labels.
